links.outcome: Accuracy of references and citations in chatbot drug information answers
links.effect: 15% of ChatGPT answers were completely inaccurate and included fake/unreliable references, versus 5% of Gemini's; only 19% of answers for each were fully accurate with reliable references.
links.quote: Fifteen percent of answers by ChatGPT were completely inaccurate and included fake/unreliable references, while 5% of Gemini's answers were categorized as such.

links.outcome: Accuracy of chatbot responses against DI pharmacist answers on a 3-point scale
links.effect: ChatGPT and Gemini were completely accurate with reliable references 19% of the time; 66% (ChatGPT) and 76% (Gemini) were partially correct and/or had incomplete resources.
links.quote: ChatGPT and Gemini were both completely accurate, with reliable references provided 19% of the time.

screen.reason: The study evaluates the accuracy and reference quality of ChatGPT and Gemini on 300 real-world drug information questions compared to pharmacists' responses, but it does not test a specific deployment safeguard or practice.
